theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only clear leader (rank 1, score 1.10) and the single eligible theme with any standing above cash (r10 0.025, durability_bar 0.54). The one-narrative structure plus mean-revert hurst tag is NOT a buy trigger — on this mean-reverting tape the gate does not hold — but as a low-conviction lean the existing leadership/flow concentration (absorption 0.33, one_narrative true) is consistent with a continuation in the very near term rather than an immediate reversal. This is expressed as a conditional: stay with the leader while it remains eligible, cap rather than add at crowding levels.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.095 and eligible=true (the only leader)
headline r10 0.0252 with one_narrative true and breadth 0.50
not crowded (crowding_z 0.78, crowded false) so no size-down flag fires

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the challenger (rank 2, score 1.03) and one of only two eligible themes, with the strongest breadth (0.944) and a trend hurst tag — the healthiest trend-quality profile on the board. But crowding_z 1.74 (crowded=true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a fade. Underweight here means don't add into the crowding; it does not say short the sector. The lean is a de-risking expression: Banks' leadershi­p is real but crowded, and on a mean-reverting tape the add-on risk from crowding is asymmetric to the downside.
evidence: rank 2, eligible=true, durability_bar 0.78 (highest on the board)
breadth 0.944 — broadest participation of any theme
crowding_z 1.74 and crowded=true — a down-size flag, not a sell
